title: TTF Surges 5.6% to €47.10 on First Hormuz LNG Transit — HH Drifts Near $2.68
edito: Hormuz Day 64 brings a potential inflection: the first LNG tanker to cross the strait since the war began. Yet one transit does not break a blockade — and Europe enters injection season at its lowest April storage since 2018. The council audited 18 trade ideas and retained 10: the core conviction is a barbell of calendar spreads and tail-risk calls, with unanimous support for the TTF Jun €55 call as the cheapest insurance in a binary market.
